notes: The census reuses profiles::dmc3::ResourcePathPolicy::archive (flags 0x0E) so the product normalizer, not a second implementation, is the census authority.
surface_sha256 binds the exact central-directory CSV this receipt was computed from; archive_sha256 binds the archive that surface was taken from.
Zero collisions means the CRT qsort/bsearch duplicate-winner indeterminacy described in docs/gdspaces/l2-archive-index-duplicate-key-reverse-2026-08-26.md cannot arise for this artifact.
This result covers dmc3-0.nbz only. Every additional volume in a claimed resolver scope needs its own census, plus a cross-volume census, before the scope-wide statement can be made.
The repository intentionally stores the aggregate receipt, not the member-name surface itself (Constitution Article V).
